_readme: Edit this file to change the Our Team section on /about, then run: node build-pages.cjs. 'photo' is a file in project-images-for-website/team/ (null shows initials). 'focus' is the CSS object-position for the photo crop.

members.name: Gunjeet Singh
members.desc: Leads the studio's brand, communication and marketing, shaping how our work, process and values reach the people we design for.

members.name: Yakshita Katyal
members.desc: Leads interior concepts, space planning and material palettes, guiding design development from first layouts to detailed working drawings.

members.name: Tanvi Maru
members.desc: Keeps clients informed and supported at every stage, coordinating updates, approvals and communication between homeowners and the studio team.

members.name: Rishabh Jain
members.desc: Manages accounts, billing and vendor payments, keeping every estimate, invoice and project ledger clear, accurate and on record.

members.name: Vidisha Chaudhary
members.desc: Designs custom furniture and joinery, balancing proportion, comfort, materials and buildability so each piece belongs to the space it is made for.

members.name: Shravan Kumar
members.desc: Develops thoughtful interior concepts, spatial layouts and material palettes that balance functionality with the character of each space.

members.name: Salman
members.desc: Coordinates on-site activities, monitors workmanship and supports the smooth execution of design and construction details.

members.name: Ar. Kunal Sangtani
members.desc: Shapes spatial planning and architectural detailing, making sure layouts, proportions and building elements work together as one coherent design.

members.name: Er. Aashish Bhardwaj
members.desc: Supports structural planning and engineering coordination to help ensure safe, practical and technically sound building solutions.

members.name: Lavdeep Singh Chahal
members.desc: Captures spaces, materials and architectural details through considered visual storytelling and cinematic composition, documenting each project as it comes to life.
